title: Diagnose silent worker post-flight auto-commit failure
description: All of 2026-07-31 the fleet completed tasks into REVIEW/DONE but the moe-agent wrapper post-flight never committed or pushed (autoCommit defaults on, no qualityGate set, branch was moe/work-2026-07-31 so branch-safety should pass, no PUSH-BLOCKED chat messages). A human session landed everything manually. Reproduce: run a worker via the JetBrains Agents menu on a task that reaches REVIEW; capture wrapper stdout; find why the auto-commit path is skipped or failing silently. Fix + add a chat escalation when the commit step errors.
definitionOfDone: root cause identified with wrapper log evidence
auto-commit fires on REVIEW in a live run (commit visible in git log)
silent-failure path now posts a chat warning
postflight harness test covers the regression
